_comment: One list per EC year; ranges are contiguous so an employee always resolves a holiday list on any date. 2018 EC tail covers the stretch between the FY 2019 EC start (2026-07-08) and the start of the 2019 EC list (2026-09-11).
_weekly_off_changed: 2026-11-10: both AIG lists now declare Sunday as the weekly off. Before this, neither list declared one, so a leave application crossing 2026-09-10/11 counted Sundays on one side of the boundary and not the other.

holiday_lists.name: AIG Holidays 2018 EC (tail: Jul - Sept 2026)
holiday_lists.needs_confirmation_note: No fixed Ethiopian public holiday falls between 2026-07-08 and 2026-09-10. Both 2026 movable Islamic holidays (Eid al-Fitr ~2026-03-20, Eid al-Adha ~2026-05-27) fall before this window, so this list carries the weekly off only. Re-check against the published calendar before the pay cycle closes.
